overview: The commission approved environmental permits for parking lot improvements at 28 Sycamore, road work on Mystic River Road, and a backyard retaining wall at 53 Wentworth Road. All approvals included specific conservation conditions for tree preservation, invasive species management, and resource area monitoring.

items.title: 28 Sycamore Continuation
items.summary: Approved the project with conditions including invasive species management and a three-year monitoring period for new plantings. The revised plan reduces parking to twelve spaces to preserve two 36-inch trees and increases compensatory storage to address neighbor concerns regarding flooding.

items.title: Mystic River Road Improvements
items.summary: Approved the Notice of Intent for road improvements with a condition requiring consultation with the tree warden during grading activities. The commission reviewed revised plans to protect existing tree roots and discussed updated FEMA flood maps that remove several area homes from the designated floodplain.

items.title: 53 Wentworth Road
items.summary: Approved the installation of a retaining wall and fence to serve as a permanent barrier between the residential yard and the wetland resource area. The commission required the installation of wetland signage and the use of a specific native seed mix for restoration.

items.title: Minutes and Administrative Business
items.summary: The commission discussed new software for transcribing minutes and upcoming applications for properties on Ronald Lee Road. Members shared observations regarding unauthorized clearing and trail activity in the woods behind Whitmore Brook Road.
